text: routes.conf registers the liveness probe twice, which is why the loader warns. Remove the extra liveness location, leave the API block, then run sh ./fb3-09-gate.sh

arguments.command:
sed -n '1,240p' routes.conf && printf '
--- gate ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' fb3-09-gate.sh && printf '
--- status ---
' && git status --short

pwd; ls -la; printf '
--- all routes references ---
'; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git 'quay_liveness\|location /api\|liveness' . 2>/dev/null || true; printf '
--- routes bytes ---
'; od -An -tx1c routes.conf

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('routes.conf')
s = p.read_text()
extra = "location /quay_liveness {\n    return 200 'ok';\n}\n"
assert s.count(extra) == 1, 'Expected exactly one removable liveness block'
p.write_text(s.replace(extra, '', 1))
PY
sh ./fb3-09-gate.sh
status=$?
printf '\n--- routes.conf ---\n'
cat routes.conf
printf '\n--- .effects.log ---\n'
cat .effects.log
exit "$status"
